contract.purpose: Make the public docs-site entry and install surfaces identify MAGRA as the product.
contract.scope: Docs landing metadata, install commands, top navigation, footer, and hero terminal examples.

interfaces.interface-3: docs/src/nav.jsx, docs/src/footer.jsx, and docs/src/hero.jsx visible product signals

invariants.invariant-1: Docs entry title, metadata, and install commands are MAGRA-first.
invariants.invariant-2: Primary docs links point to `anyagixx/MAGRA` or MAGRA release surfaces.
invariants.invariant-3: Deep upstream docs can remain only when clearly labeled as upstream compatibility/history.
